title: Last Bell, 2005
logline: School lets out. Wood is at the hospital in Newport at 3:05. The bell rings in a panel he isn't in.

panels.composition: Small Wood High, 3:05 PM, the bell, kids pouring out. Nobody we know. The strip draws it anyway.

image.prompt: a small-town high school at the last bell with students pouring out, nobody in particular, muddy digital flats, a bell sound drawn jagged

panels.composition: Newport. The lot with the VISITOR sign. The Datsun. WOOD in it with BARNABY. 3:05 on the dash clock.

image.prompt: an old Datsun in a parking lot beside a VISITOR sign, a man and a dog inside, the dashboard clock reading 3:05
image.notes: Same minute, two places. The bell rings in a town he isn't in.

panels.composition: Wood, listening to nothing. He can't hear it from here.

image.prompt: close-up of a man in a parked car listening for something he can't hear, no words

panels.composition: The two panels side by side conceptually — the strip draws the lot again, wider, the building cropped, and in the sky, very faint, the bell's jagged shape from panel 1, as if it carried.
props: a faint bell shape in the sky

image.prompt: a wide rainy parking lot with a small old Datsun before a cropped institutional building, and very faintly in the sky the jagged shape of a distant bell sound, no words

art.line: brush-pen scanned; muddy digital flats; Sundays in watercolor, improving
art.palette: limited, muddy; Sundays gray-green, rust, one warm

notes: Last Bell rung in a town he isn't in. The father, again, as a parking lot.
